scenario: Same as above but on ZZQA AlphaOne, whose cumulative 2026 bonus allowance is used up by prior bonus runs (bonus 5,400 == AlphaOne's 15% cap)

Dev to confirm the stacking basis is intentional and correct.

scenario: Measure time-to-content (real data visible, not skeleton) on a cold client-side load of key routes as Broni; capture the network waterfall via the Resource Timing API
expected: Content ready within ~2-3 s

Every route also does: GET /user TWICE (~2.6 s then ~5.3 s), GET /organization-data (9-28 s), GET /setup-completion (4.5-5.4 s) — all serial before content paints. DOM-ready is fast (~300-480 ms) so it's entirely backend/orchestration latency + duplicate & repeated requests, not bundle size (transfer ~10 KB). Icon-font fetches also each fail after ~1.3 s (BETA-F-003).
